Hi Habeeb,

I’m a passionate, hard-working creator with 7 years of experience building clear, polished digital products and explaining complex topics in a simple way. While my background is in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, and full stack development, I’m very comfortable creating screen-based walkthroughs and concise step-by-step explanations.

One relevant project was a live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight, where I built a dispatcher map showing every truck’s position and ETA as GPS pings arrived. It tracked 1,800 trucks live and kept updates under 2 seconds from ping to screen.

I’d be glad to create informative comparison, review, and tutorial videos for your channel. I can work within clear deadlines, communicate clearly on voice, and adapt quickly to your style. I can also provide a voice sample with my message.
